title: Build Match Assessment worker and API
head: 3c97c27

gates.alembic: head unchanged t4e5f6a7b8c9 (no migration in this issue)

acceptance.ac: POST /match-assessments validates exact versions and ensures/validates the active Job Target
acceptance.evidence: create() loads JD/Resume versions (AssessmentVersionNotFoundError 409, AssessmentInputNotReadyError 409) and ensures the active target from the JD identity or the supplied job_target_id; MatchScopeMismatchError maps to 422. Integration tests: test_create_persists_queued_then_broker_failure_is_safe_diagnostic, test_create_active_duplicate_conflict.

acceptance.ac: Return a reused completed assessment or persist queued and dispatch after commit
acceptance.evidence: pick_create reuses completed unless force (200 with reused=true) or raises 409 for an active duplicate with the safe ID; new rows persist queued with run_id and dispatch only after commit. Tests: test_create_reuses_completed_without_force, test_create_force_new_row_after_completion.

acceptance.ac: Worker builds catalog, applies deterministic/semantic stages, and finalizes only under current run ownership
acceptance.evidence: MatchAssessmentWorker.evaluate guards (missing/stale), sets evaluating, builds the Source Catalog, runs ConstrainedSemanticMatcher through the gateway + PrivacyGuard, evaluates the deterministic engine, and completes under lifecycle.complete(run_id). The worker rolls back before any provider call so no external call holds a transaction. Tests: test_worker_completes_with_immutable_result, test_stale_worker_exits_without_result_write.

acceptance.ac: Broker failure, dependency timeout, invalid evidence, terminal failure, and explicit retry persist safe state
acceptance.evidence: Broker failure persists ASSESSMENT_DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT/retryable=true (deterministic via patched dispatch); structured MatchSemanticError flags classify evidence_invalid (terminal, ASSESSMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID) vs retryable (ASSESSMENT_FAILED/ASSESSMENT_DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT); retry clears the diagnostic, bumps attempt, and requeues the same row with a new run_id. Tests: test_create_persists_queued_then_broker_failure_is_safe_diagnostic, test_retry_failed_clears_diagnostic_and_requeues.

acceptance.ac: Add cursor list, detail, and retry endpoints with public immutable result schemas
acceptance.evidence: GET /match-assessments returns newest-first cursor pages with a terminal cursor (next_before_id=null on the final page), GET /{id} returns status or the completed immutable result only (never provider raw output), POST /{id}/retry takes no body. Queries.get uses populate_existing so detail always reflects committed state. Tests: test_list_cursor_and_detail (pages, terminal cursor, 404).

acceptance.ac: Integration tests cover reuse, force, active duplicate, retry, stale worker, and low-score eligibility
acceptance.evidence: test_create_reuses_completed_without_force, test_create_force_new_row_after_completion, test_create_active_duplicate_conflict, test_retry_failed_clears_diagnostic_and_requeues, test_stale_worker_exits_without_result_write, test_low_score_still_returns_completed_result (low scores return a normal completed result with recommendation=reject; they never block eligibility).

reviews.note: All 6 acceptance criteria verified by integration tests; worker/API layering per RIP-013 §7/§9 (application-owned ORM boundary; API never imports models); structured MatchSemanticError flags replace string matching; cursor list emits a terminal cursor; retry endpoint matches the no-body contract. Arch-check clean (0 new violations). Browser acceptance n/a (backend issue).

residual_risks: Real LLM/provider path (non-fake matcher) is not exercised in integration tests; it is covered by matcher unit tests and the worker's rollback-before-provider-call invariant.
Task timeout (240s) and broker retry behavior are Celery-level and not integration-tested here.
